name: Channel 4 - Car builds (no characters)
about: Reference: ZerryCars. Low-poly cars and engines in a bright tiled garage and on a tree-lined drag strip; no characters, one fast casual narrator; big HUD meters (HP, PSI, RPM) with a rival marker; callout labels on a thin line; engine cutaways with moving pistons; 'what if' builds and head-to-head tests.
paint_style: Clean low-poly 3D render of cars and engines, bright daylight, white tiled garage, saturated colours
formula: hook: two things side by side and one shocking number (meter on screen), ask how/what if
baseline: the normal one with its meter
build: one upgrade per line, each bumps a meter (rpm, boost, hp) on a close-up part
the catch (WAIT...), then the clever trick that beats it
the test: drag race or dyno with the numbers, last line loops to the first
parts: sets/parts.py: @engine (cyl, layout I|V, induction none|turbo|twin_turbo|supercharger|electric, cutaway, block, cover, run), @turbo (size, run), @supercharger (electric), @stand (h), @strip, @start_tree, @finish

shot_layers.hud: edit/hud.py meter: label, from, to, max, rival, rival_label, color, fmt
